# Client Payment Receipt Template v1

## Purpose

This is the standard v1 receipt format for client payments across AMA / Hanzo client engagements.

Use this whenever a client payment is received for:

- project activation deposits
- milestone payments
- gate payments
- retainers
- reimbursements
- revenue-share payments
- final balance payments

The goal is to keep every receipt clear, professional, audit-ready, and easy to store across Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, and GitHub.

This v1 template is intentionally clean and direct. A future MAIM OS branded version can upgrade the visual design with the new MAIM color scheme.

---

# Receipt Structure

## Header

**Payment Receipt**

**Project:** [Client / Project Name]

**Receipt Type:** [Gate / Milestone / Retainer / Deposit / Final Payment]

**Prepared By:** Major Dream Williams / AMA-Hanzo Systems

**Prepared For:** [Client Name / Client Business]

**Date Issued:** [Receipt Issue Date]

---

# Payment Confirmation

This receipt confirms that payment has been received for the following engagement:

**Client / Project:** [Client / Project Name]

**Payment Purpose:** [Example: Gate 1 Project Reactivation Deposit]

**Amount Received:** $[Amount] USD

**Date Received:** [Payment Date]

**Payment Method:** [Zelle / Venmo / Wire / Stripe / Cash App / Bank Transfer / Other]

**Confirmation / Transaction ID:** [Confirmation Number]

**Payment Recipient / Receiving Account:** [Receiving Account or Authorized Recipient]

---

# Payment Application

This payment is applied as follows:

- **Total Project Value:** $[Total Project Value]
- **Amount Received This Payment:** $[Amount]
- **Total Paid to Date:** $[Total Paid to Date]
- **Remaining Balance:** $[Remaining Balance]
- **Current Gate / Milestone Activated:** [Gate / Milestone Name]

If this payment was received through a temporary or third-party authorized channel, include language such as:

> This payment was sent to [Authorized Recipient Name] as a temporary authorized payment recipient on behalf of Major Dream Williams / AMA-Hanzo Systems. Future payments should be made only through the updated written payment instructions provided by AMA-Hanzo Systems.

---

# Scope / Gate Activation Note

This payment activates:

- [Activated scope item 1]
- [Activated scope item 2]
- [Activated scope item 3]

No additional gate or milestone work is activated until the next scheduled payment is received, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

---

# Ownership / Credit Note

This payment is credited toward the agreed project value. It does not change the agreed ownership, IP, handover, support, revision, or performance-alignment terms unless expressly updated in writing.

---

# Internal Logging Checklist

After receipt is created, log it in:

- Google Drive payment folder
- Airtable client/project record
- Notion project page
- GitHub docs/templates or client docs if needed

Recommended Drive folder naming:

```text
00_ADMIN / 02_Invoices_Receipts_Payment_Proof
```

Recommended file naming:

```text
[Client]_[Project]_Payment_Receipt_[Gate-or-Milestone]_[YYYY-MM-DD].pdf
```

---

# Client Send Note

Use this simple message when sending the receipt:

```text
Confirming receipt of the [amount] payment for [project / gate / milestone].

This payment has been applied toward the agreed project value and activates [gate / milestone]. I have attached the receipt for your records.

Thank you for moving this forward.
```
